about: Tree -> text -> tree is exact: strings with escapes, inf and nan, sets of enum values in settings, a color as its tuple (spec/reference.md, 2, 5 and 8). A case is a whole `text`; `formatted` is how it prints back, `error` the line:col of the error that refuses it and `message` its message. Read by python/tests/test_conformance.py and rust/tests/conformance.rs.

cases.name: string_escapes
cases.about: Every escape of a string, printed as written: a quote, a backslash, the line breaks, a tab, other control characters

cases.name: string_escapes_canonical
cases.about: A string prints in one spelling: \u{…} of a character that needs none is the character, in lowercase hex with no leading zeros where one is needed; a raw tab is \t

cases.name: quoted_names_with_escapes
cases.about: A name in quotes takes the escapes too: a graph, an input with its key, a panel, a description, a frame, a look, a socket

cases.name: use_source_with_escapes
cases.about: The file a use names is a string too

cases.name: qualified_name_quoted
cases.about: A graph of a module whose name is no identifier is called by its name in quotes

cases.name: qualified_name_chain
cases.about: After the module, a chain of identifiers needs no quotes: `m::"x::y"` is the name `m::x::y`

cases.name: unknown_escape
cases.about: An escape the language does not know is refused at its backslash, with the escapes
cases.message: unknown escape '\q': a string's escapes are \", \\, \n, \t, \r and \u{…}, a character's code in 1 to 6 hex digits

cases.name: escape_u_without_braces
cases.about: \u takes its code in braces
cases.message: unknown escape '\u': a string's escapes are \", \\, \n, \t, \r and \u{…}, a character's code in 1 to 6 hex digits

cases.name: escape_u_empty
cases.about: \u{} has no code
cases.message: unknown escape '\u{}': a string's escapes are \", \\, \n, \t, \r and \u{…}, a character's code in 1 to 6 hex digits

cases.name: escape_u_too_long
cases.about: \u{…} takes 6 hex digits at most
cases.message: unknown escape '\u{0000041}': a string's escapes are \", \\, \n, \t, \r and \u{…}, a character's code in 1 to 6 hex digits

cases.name: escape_u_past_unicode
cases.about: \u{…} past 10ffff is no character
cases.message: unknown escape '\u{110000}': a string's escapes are \", \\, \n, \t, \r and \u{…}, a character's code in 1 to 6 hex digits

cases.name: escape_u_surrogate
cases.about: \u{…} of a surrogate is no character
cases.message: unknown escape '\u{d800}': a string's escapes are \", \\, \n, \t, \r and \u{…}, a character's code in 1 to 6 hex digits

cases.name: line_break_in_string
cases.about: A raw line break inside a string leaves it unclosed: a line break is written \n

cases.name: inf_and_nan
cases.about: inf and nan are float literals, -inf the negation of inf: as a value, a default, a range, a setting

cases.name: nan_has_no_sign
cases.about: A NaN prints nan, whatever its sign

cases.name: words_like_inf
cases.about: Only the words themselves are numbers: inf_x, Inf and nan2 are names

cases.name: digits_stay_finite
cases.about: A float written with digits must be finite: inf is how infinity is written

cases.name: inf_bound
cases.about: inf is a reserved word: no name binds it
cases.message: 'inf' is a reserved word: choose another name

cases.name: true_bound
cases.about: Nor does a name bind a keyword
cases.message: 'true' is a reserved word: choose another name

cases.name: nan_input
cases.about: A graph's input is no reserved word
cases.message: 'nan' is a reserved word: choose another name

cases.name: inf_graph
cases.about: Nor a graph's name
cases.message: 'inf' is a reserved word: choose another name

cases.name: inf_key
cases.about: Nor the key an input takes with as
cases.message: 'inf' is a reserved word: choose another name

cases.name: inf_item
cases.about: Nor an item
cases.message: 'inf' is a reserved word: choose another name

cases.name: nan_type_parameter
cases.about: Nor a template's type
cases.message: 'nan' is a reserved word: choose another name

cases.name: reserved_socket_quoted
cases.about: A socket named like a reserved word is written in quotes

cases.name: flag_set_one
cases.about: A set of enum values, Blender's flag enums, is a tuple: one value takes a trailing comma

cases.name: flag_set_empty
cases.about: The empty set is ()

cases.name: flag_set_two
cases.about: Several values, as any tuple

cases.name: flag_set_parentheses
cases.about: Without a comma, parentheses hold the value alone

cases.name: color_is_a_tuple
cases.about: A color is written as its tuple: `#` starts a frame's or a look's color, no value

cases.name: color_is_a_tuple_in_arguments
cases.about: Nor is `#rgb` a value given to an input

cases.name: color_is_a_tuple_in_settings
cases.about: Nor a setting's value
cases.message: expected a setting's value (a literal, an enum value, a tuple), found '#ff8800'

cases.name: color_as_tuple
cases.about: The tuple a color is written as
